bus_bytes.description: Local-rank estimated link traffic, includes collective algorithm factor; zero when inactive.
bus_bytes.title: Bus Bytes

group.description: Parallel group name (tp/ep/pp/dp) or a rule-declared group.
group.title: Group

logical_bytes.description: Local-rank logical tensor bytes per prefill invocation; use T=S for decode.
logical_bytes.title: Logical Bytes

notes.description: Ring/dispatch/routing assumptions, especially EP uniform routing.
notes.title: Notes

op.description: Logical collective; fused kernels retain semantic communication metadata.
op.title: Op

when.description: Activation condition; inactive communication contributes zero.
when.title: When

decode.description: Work for one decode step of S local-attention sequences.
decode.title: Decode

prefill.description: Work per prefill chunk of T local-attention tokens.
prefill.title: Prefill

ascend.description: PEP 440 SpecifierSet for vllm-ascend; empty means any.
ascend.title: Ascend

class.description: Exact qualified class or exact short class name; qualified match wins, no glob/regex matching.
class.title: Class

vllm.description: PEP 440 SpecifierSet; empty means any. For development commits use base package version plus snapshot identity.
vllm.title: Vllm

when.description: Additional DSL applicability predicate over declared symbols/attrs/params.
when.title: When

dtype.description: Dtype symbol or builtin dtype name, consumed by bytes().
dtype.title: Dtype

name.description: Local input/output slot name; multiple inputs/outputs stay separate.
name.title: Name

shape.description: Local-rank dimensions as DSL expressions, in dimension order.

items.description: Expression in docs/expr-dsl.md; never a JSON number.

shape.title: Shape

comm.description: Collective metadata or null; same representation as IR.

flops.description: Phase-specific FLOP expressions, not a scalar shorthand.

id.description: Stable rule key; multiple matching rules are an error, never pick by file order.
id.title: Id

match.description: Class, upstream version ranges and optional predicate.

notes.description: Assumptions and explanation of non-obvious formula terms.
notes.title: Notes

out.description: Output tensor slots with expression dimensions, same representation as IR.
out.title: Out

shard.description: Parallel axis to shard dimension/strategy, converted into IR parallel axes.
shard.title: Shard

weight.description: Resident local-rank weight bytes expression, including scale/padding overhead when modelled.
weight.title: Weight
